items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Harry was the boss, he was the boss -- I never knew his last name.

ctx.x: Harry was the boss, he was the boss -- I never knew his last name. Harry, I just said 'Harry, you know what, these colored entertainers used to give us 50 cents or split half and now these girls are only giving us 10 cents.' He said 'I can't help it.' So I think this is near the first of the week. I said, 'well, I'm getting through Saturday,' because our tips went from say, $15 a night to $3 and $4. I said 'we can't do that!'

So I quit. Now while I was there, this guy used to come over and sit in back with his hat on and always send a waiter up and tell the band to play such and such a number and he would never send any money so I told Harry, 'see that guy sitting down there, he's been here every night and he hasn't sent us a nickel.' He said 'you know who that is.' I said no. He said 'that's Jack Legs Diamond. He's a gangster. Let him alone.' So we quit that night and you know the next Monday night they raided the place and Alphonso…
